_comment: External OSINT tools LeakGuard wraps. 'detect' lists binaries or paths to look for; the first match wins. The owner runs the install commands. 'pipx' (pinned) lets the desktop app install the tool with one click: pipx install --python 3.12 --fetch-missing-python <spec> (user-level, no admin rights).

tools.name: holehe
tools.purpose: email -> sites with an account registered

tools.name: h8mail
tools.purpose: email -> breach hits (free and keyed modes)

tools.name: maigret
tools.purpose: username -> profiles on 3000+ sites, with parsed profile data

tools.name: ghunt
tools.purpose: Google account -> public profile, Maps reviews, calendar, photos
tools.install: pipx install --python 3.12 --fetch-missing-python ghunt   # then: ghunt login

tools.name: blackbird
tools.install: git clone https://github.com/p1ngul1n0/blackbird ~/tools/blackbird && python3 -m venv ~/tools/blackbird/.venv && ~/tools/blackbird/.venv/bin/pip install -r ~/tools/blackbird/requirements.txt

tools.name: mosint
tools.purpose: email -> breaches, related domains, social accounts
tools.install: sudo apt install -y golang-go && go install github.com/alpkeskin/mosint/v3/cmd/mosint@latest

tools.name: theHarvester
tools.purpose: keyword/domain -> emails and hosts from many search sources

tools.name: spiderfoot
tools.purpose: OSINT framework, email/username modules, run headless

tools.name: recon-ng
tools.purpose: OSINT framework, profiler and contacts modules

tools.name: git-filter-repo
tools.purpose: rewrite own git history to remove the email
